Priya (CS): Hey team — putting together a VERY small customer-facing runbook for onboarding handoffs that focuses on prefill / caching / batching / streaming and a lightweight telemetry + feedback capture flow. Can ppl quickly review?

Alex (SRE): +1. keep it short and prescriptive. Customers like checklists. :thumbsup:

Jordan (PM): Concrete preflight steps would be great (what to verify during demo -> go-live). Also a clear renewal-risk signal section.

Sam (Eng): I can add a tiny troubleshooting snippet for common latency/bundle-size issues. Maybe recommend safe defaults for batch size and cache TTL.

Nadia (Support): Please include an example email template for the handoff and a one-click feedback link. We get a lot of ad-hoc asks otherwise.

Priya (CS): Cool — I'm drafting this as a 1-page "mini runbook" plus a single Slack thread template customers can copy. Draft below — open to edits: 

---
Mini Onboarding Runbook — Prefill + Batch + Stream (Customer-facing)
1) Quick preflight (before demo)
   - Confirm model + model size pinned for go-live.
   - Verify region & routing policy (eu/us) match customer legal needs.
   - Ensure API key & ingest pipeline tested with ~1000 warmup tokens.

2) Demo -> Go-live checklist
   - Enable prefix cache: set TTL=15m for demo traffic.
   - Set batch max_tokens=64, max_batch_size=8 for first 48h.
   - Streaming: use chunked responses for long outputs; set client read timeout to 60s.
   - Circuit-breaker: client-side 3 retries with exponential backoff (500ms -> 1s -> 2s).

3) Warm pools & priming
   - Recommend enabling a warm-pool for the first 72h with 2x expected concurrency.
   - Run a warmup script: `for i in 1..200: call /generate with short prompts` to populate KV cache.

4) Fallback policies (reduce customer risk)
   - Primary: pinned high-quality model.
   - Fallback: compatible smaller quantized variant for capacity spikes.
   - If fallback used >5% of requests in 1h, trigger CS + SRE alert.

5) Telemetry & signals to watch (SLOs + renewal risk)
   - Latency p50/p95, tokens per request, error rate, fallback ratio.
   - Renewal-risk heuristics: sustained p95 > 1.5x baseline, fallback ratio > 10%, or customer-reported quality regressions.

6) Troubleshooting snippets
   - High latency: reduce max_batch_size, reduce sequence length, check hotspot model variant.
   - Cold cache issues: increase warm-pool size or warmup script volume.

7) Customer handoff email (one-paragraph)
   - Hi <Name>, attaching the prefill plan & short runbook we used during demo. We'll monitor latency & fallback signals for 72h and loop back with adjustments. Please use this quick feedback form: <https://forms.redwood.example/onboard-feedback>.

8) Feedback capture & postmortem cadence
   - Ask customers to submit a 1–2 line feedback in the form after 48h.
   - CS will run a 30-min check-in at day 3 and document any config changes.
---

Alex (SRE): Nice. Suggestion: add a single metric alarm example (Prometheus alert) for fallback ratio > 5% over 5m.

Sam (Eng): Add a safe quantization recommendation: "int8-quant" variant works well for chat workloads with small quality drop; use only as fallback for spikes.

Jordan (PM): For renewal-risk, can we include a short wording CS can use in renewal qbrs: "we saw X — recommended Y"? Keeps messaging uniform.

Nadia (Support): Also add a short troubleshooting script customers can paste into curl for reproducing latency: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' 
 -d '{"model":"<model>","input":"hello world","stream":false}'
```

ops-bot: Reminder: create runbook doc in Confluence under Onboarding -> Prefill Runbooks when approved.

Priya (CS): OK I'll fold these in. Final ask: who can give a +1 for publishing? Also need a short subject line for the email template.

Alex (SRE): +1 from SRE.

Sam (Eng): +1, engineering ok with defaults.

Jordan (PM): +1 — suggest email subject: "Redwood onboarding plan & 72h monitoring"

Nadia (Support): +1, will use the feedback form link in tickets.

Priya (CS): Awesome — thanks all. I'll publish and ping the onboarding channel. :rocket:
